profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at PwC
profile.summary:
I am a full stack developer with several years of professional experience in software design and development. Experienced with technologies like Angular, Node, and JavaEE. I am a hard working individual that enjoys constantly learning and working in small, high performing, agile teams.  

I graduated with a Bachelor's Degree focused in Computer Engineering  from Texas A&M University.
